THE PROTEUS WAY / SCHOOL HOLIDAYS

WHO IT’S FOR

Families looking for active school holiday options, and clubs, schools or community organisations interested in hosting a programme.

01

Multi-sport days

Football, basketball, netball, touch rugby, cricket and recreational games that build fitness, teamwork and sportsmanship.

02

Performance camps

Football camps for ages 7–19 led by highly qualified coaches, including our Elevate Your Game camp with Westland United FC in Hokitika.

03

Safe and structured

Organised, well-supervised days that support families and connect local schools, clubs and the wider community.

HERE TO HELP

GOOD
QUESTIONS.

Ask us something else
How much does a holiday programme cost?

Our most recent football performance camp was $60 per day, per player, with family discounts available. Pricing is confirmed with each programme.

What ages are the programmes for?

Football performance camps are for ages 7 to 19. Details vary between programmes, so check the information for the specific programme before booking.

How do I book a place?

Email oliver@proteus.nz or use our enquiry form and choose Holiday Programmes. We’ll send the dates, locations and registration details for upcoming programmes.

Which programme is right for us?

Tell us who the programme is for, your sport and what you want to achieve. Our team can discuss the options for an individual player, preschool, school, club, community organisation or retirement village.
